author: TECHDEV
description: Did these deployed model weights change since I pinned them? A zero-dependency CLI that pins model weights to a sha256 lockfile and gates CI on byte-level drift (CLEAN / CHANGED / MISSING / NEW) - local only, no network, no signing infrastructure.
name: weightpin

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/unit.test.js test/e2e.test.js
